inputs.name: registerImpactCommand.program
inputs.description: The Commander Command program on which the impact subcommand is registered. It must provide the chained .command, .option, .description, and .action methods used here; this implementation does not check another program shape.

outputs.name: registerImpactCommand
outputs.description: Registration returns no value (void). The supplied program gains an impact command with --base defaulting to HEAD, optional --head, --runtime, and --json; its action awaits runImpact(flags) and prints JSON when --json is set or renderImpact(report) otherwise.

errors.name: runImpact rejection
errors.description: When the registered async action runs, it rejects with the failure value from runImpact(flags) if that awaited call rejects; this file does not name or translate the rejection.
